summary: T13 all-day semantics verified: single/multi-day dates round-trip as timezone-independent DATE values across DST boundaries, edits preserve all-day representation, and mixed DATE/DATE-TIME values are rejected. All 7 T13 tests plus the full backend suite (155 lib + 66 caldav_event_resource + integration) pass; cargo check and clippy are clean.
important_context: All-day events are stored as plain ISO calendar dates (all_day_start_date/all_day_end_date) and rendered as VALUE=DATE with exclusive end, so they are inherently timezone-independent and unaffected by DST.
Mixed DATE/DATE-TIME rejection is enforced in the ics.rs parser timing() function (falls to the InvalidEvent catch-all) and surfaced as HTTP 400 in the DAV PUT create/update paths.
No production code changes were needed; all acceptance criteria are already satisfied by the prior stage's implementation and its tests.
